supersedes: v1 event analysis only; v1 used an evaluation-derived per-world 90th percentile and is invalid for protocol event claims
role: exposed development/calibration validation; not test or confirmation evidence
estimator_scope: retained selected public-backbone algorithm; no citizen estimator passed v6 selection
strata: declared cell group x estimate age x public reference-scale tertile; tertile cuts fitted on calibration public scales
event_definition: one fixed 95th percentile of calibration-split truth; frozen before and unchanged throughout evaluation
fallback: declared strata with fewer than 100 calibration residuals use pooled clock-specific radii
provenance: calibration targets and event threshold close after model selection and before the disjoint exposed evaluation split; evaluation API cannot refit radii
scientific_limit: no selected v6 citizen estimator exists; results validate the public-backbone interval pipeline only and make no exact conformal or conditional-coverage claim
